                                  access you approve"

App Shop Web

Guest grant
  +  https://api.shop.example  scopes: orders:read, checkout

File
  +  auth0-poppy.json  new

To apply:  auth0 poppy setup --company-domain shop.example \
             --api https://api.shop.example \
             --api-url https://api.shop.example=https://api.shop.example/openapi.json \
             --app "Shop Web" --scope "refunds=Refund an order you placed." \
             --scope "wishlist=Keep a list of things you want." \
             --login-uri https://shop.example/login --guest-api-access \
             --guest-scopes checkout,orders:read
